Chapter 6391: Stolen?

Chapter 6391: Stolen?

“Not like we can do anything about it now.” The second said.

“I don’t know what happened, the dream and this.” The first said.

“No difference, both came from the body.” The second said.

“Right.” The first nodded before contemplating: “Should we go burn him?”

“Should we?” The second wondered.

“Should we burn him?” Both stared at Li Qiye.

“Ghosts are afraid of fire, sure.” Li Qiye said.

“Let’s burn the boss then.” The second found this logical.

“Fine, we won’t be unlucky anymore.” The first nodded.

“Wait, wait. If we burn the boss, who are we going to stay with from now on?” The second said.

“Go home, no more staying here.” The first said.

“There’s no one home either.” The second shook his head: “The boss has a son, maybe we can stay with him.”

“I’ve never met him.” The first said.

“True, me too.” The second said.

“Must have been later, after the boss left home.” The first stroked his chin.

“That’s our home, not the boss’ home.” The second said.

“Don’t we have the same home?” The first asked.

“Then is our home his son’s home?” The second asked.

“Can’t be. It’s our home, not his home.” The first jumped up and said: “Hmm, should we tell him about the good stuff we left there?”

“Why should we tell him, it’s ours.” The second said.

“I thought they belonged to the boss.” The first said.

“But the boss is dead.” The second said.

“Why are we even here? Traveled so far to get to this forsaken place and got injured. Too.” The first lamented.

“We have to tell the boss or his son about it.” The second said.

“Yeah, tell it to the corpse.” The first shook his head.

“Isn’t it alive again?” The second said.

“Just an unlucky ghost, so it’s useless to tell him.” The first said.

“Right, no longer the boss.” The second agreed.

“Well, he never used it anyway and it’s not like he’s coming back.” The first pondered.

“Right.” The second agreed.

“So are we heading back?” The first asked: “No, the boss isn’t returning with us, no point.”

“But we have to watch our home, someone might steal the good stuff.” The second said.

“No one will, we hid it so well.” The first said.

“Who knows, those dogs have good noses.” The second said.

“You’re right. We almost died for it, we can’t let those dogs steal it.” The first said.

“We took it back, we’re amazing.” The second said.

“No, the bastard got swept and we came across it by chance.” The first said.

“Right, it’s been a while.” The second said: “We have to keep an eye on it then.”

“Is it useful?” The first asked.

“Useful?” The second had no response.

“It’s useless, why do we need it if we’re not going higher?” The first said.

“But it’s good.” The second said.

“The boss said it was good stuff, not us.” The first said.

“Yeah, we can’t eat it, maybe it’s not good.” The second said: “Wait, it’s been eighty million years, so that’s how much it is worth.”

“Right, it can be traded for a lot of money.” The first said.

“So we’re not leaving it for the boss?” The second said.

“Not when he’s dead.” The first said: “He’s a ghost now and doesn’t care for it.”

“Right, he never thought about going home.” The second said.

“It’s because it is not his home, that’s why the bastard doesn’t want to go back.” The first said.

“Don’t call the boss that, he might be a bastard but he’s still the boss.” The second said.

“Fine, still the boss. We still can’t give it away though.” The first said: “And we can’t bring him back, he’s not immortal anymore. The dogs will eat him after finding out.”

“The dogs would eat a ghost?” The second rolled his eyes.

“Definitely.” The first said.

“We can’t let that happen.” The second said.

“Let’s go back.” The first said.

“Why if we’re not bringing the boss back or giving it to him?” The second said.

“Makes sense. Maybe we should give it to his son. He’s immortal, so it’s suitable.” The first said.

“Bah, I don’t know him, why should I give it to him?” The second protested.

“Because he’s the boss son.” The first said.

“Right… so we’re giving it to him?” The second said.

“What is this good stuff you two keep bringing up?” Alch-deer interjected.

“None of your business, you’re not the boss’ son!” Both yelled at him.
